steps.caption: LSA Leads
steps.narration: This is LSA Leads. It pulls the leads from your Google Local Services Ads accounts into one list, and shows which ones you were charged for.

steps.caption: Syncs on its own schedule
steps.narration: Leads sync in the background on their own schedule. The connection shows when the last sync ran.

steps.caption: Every account your sign-in can reach
steps.narration: Every Google Ads account your sign-in can reach is listed here, with how many leads it has and how many you were charged for.

steps.caption: Open an account
steps.narration: Open an account to see its leads.

steps.caption: Leads, charged, disputed, spend
steps.narration: The top row counts total leads, charged leads, how many you've disputed, and the total spend.

steps.caption: Each lead: contact, service, type, charge
steps.narration: Each lead shows the contact, the service, whether it came as a call, message or booking, and whether Google charged you for it.

steps.caption: More details
steps.narration: Choose More details for the lead status, the credit state, and the Google lead ID.

steps.caption: Good or Bad
steps.narration: Under each lead you mark it Good, or report it as Bad.

steps.caption: You pick the reason
steps.narration: You pick the reason: a service you don't offer, a sales call, a duplicate, outside your area, or a customer who wasn't ready to book.

steps.caption: Report sends it to Google
steps.narration: Report sends the reason to Google. Google decides on any credit, and nothing is ever reported on its own.

steps.caption: Disputed leads
steps.narration: The Disputed filter shows the leads you've reported. A reported lead can't be reported twice.

steps.caption: Menu: Google Ads, LSA Leads
steps.narration: You'll find LSA Leads in the menu on the left, under Google Ads.

youtube.title: LSA Leads in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of LSA Leads in ConstructHUB: every Google Local Services Ads account in one list, each account's leads with the charged ones marked, and a Good or Bad rating on every lead with a reason you choose that goes to Google.
